title: Ear piercing
what: The earlobe is pierced with a sterile instrument, and an earring is put in right away. It takes a few minutes.
why: At an adult's own wish, or a parent's wish for a child.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 15 minutes; healing usually takes 6 to 8 weeks
tell_doctor: A tendency to form keloid scars
For a child: recent illnesses and vaccines

prepare.title: Health
prepare.text: Piercing is done when you or your child are well, with no fever or cold.

prepare.title: Hair
prepare.text: Pull your hair away from your ears with a clip or hair tie.

prepare.title: For a child
prepare.text: Calmly explain to your child that it will be quick and only a little unpleasant.

bring: The parent's ID and the child's birth certificate, if a child is being pierced
steps: The earlobes are cleaned with antiseptic
The spots are marked with a pen. You check that they are even
Sometimes a numbing cream is put on
A quick piercing, and the earring goes in right away
The back is fastened, and the spot is cleaned again
You are told how to care for the piercing
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
The earlobe may burn and look red for a few hours
after: Do not take out the first earrings for 6 to 8 weeks, or as long as you are told
Clean the earlobes with antiseptic 1 to 2 times a day
Do not touch the piercings with dirty hands
For a few weeks, do not swim in pools, lakes, or the sea
red_flags: The earlobe is very swollen, painful, or has pus
The back or the earring has sunk into the earlobe

faq.q: At what age can a child have their ears pierced?
faq.a: There is no strict age. Many parents wait until the child can care for their ears. Ask your pediatrician.

faq.q: When can I change the earrings?
faq.a: Usually after 6 to 8 weeks, when the piercing has healed. At first, smooth earrings made of a hypoallergenic metal are best.

reminders.text: Ear piercing soon. Pull your hair back and bring your ID. If there is a fever, it is better to reschedule.
